sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Shared base rules
sections.what: Sets the parser, the plugins, the starter rule sets, and the project's own rule list.
sections.why: Keeps the rules for all packages in one place.
sections.watch_out: A rule marked as an error here can be downgraded by the root config, so the result depends on which file runs.

summary: Shared base lint rules for TypeScript code, reused by the other lint configs in the monorepo.
purpose: Defines the core rules, such as unused variables, any-type warnings, import ordering and console use.
why: Likely reason: one shared base keeps every package on the same rules.
how: Starts from the recommended TypeScript and import rules, adds import order and console checks, and skips build output folders.
inputs: Read by the root lint config and by the other shared configs.
outputs: The rules applied to the code being checked.
risks: Written in the older config format and loaded through a compatibility helper. Some rules are errors here but are downgraded to warnings in the root config.
debug: If lint reports an unknown rule, check that its plugin is listed. Compare with the overrides in the root config.
